title: What happens when you send a Lavish page with some questions unanswered?
body:
Settled: the daemon renders a request's questions keyed to its version and can tell when every question has an answer; it collects what you send, word for word, and routes it to the owning leader; a new version reissues the page (AssemblyAI#10). The sources do not say what happens when you send some answers and leave other questions open, which happened in the planning rounds (AssemblyAI#11 round 4, for example).

Rule 29 in the draft is open until you answer.
rec: A. The leader can act on what you did answer, and the rest stays visible as waiting on you; it is also how the planning rounds worked, where questions you left open were asked again. B leaves answers you already gave sitting unused, so work that depends only on them waits for questions it does not need.
options: A: the daemon routes what you sent to the owning leader at once; the version stays pending, shown as partly answered, until every question has an answer or the leader issues a new version for the rest
B: the daemon keeps your answers until every question on the page has one, then routes them together

title: Accept 04 Conversation and Lavish?
body: Accepting applies your answer above and any annotations. I then commit the document and start 05 Repositories and job branches. If you would rather see the changes first, choose another round.
rec: A, unless your annotations change substance.
options: A: accept, with my answers and annotations applied
B: show me another round with the changes
